Method of Attack: Compromise of website to inject malicious JavaScript scripts that capture payment information entered by customers and send it to a remote server under attacker control
Discoverer: JM Bullion with assistance of a third-party forensic specialist
Attack Vector: Injected malicious JavaScript scripts on compromised website
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious scripts present on JM Bullion website from February 18, 2020 to July 17, 2020
Remote server under attacker control receiving stolen payment information
